rule: Always decouple stamina drain from frame rates by multiplying delta time into the depletion formula.
Never run line-of-sight visibility traces on every tick for off-screen entities; use an interval throttled timer.

Never generate flat, boring top-down tile grids or simple single-room box layouts. For 2.5D or perspective games, mandate dynamic pseudo-3D perspective projection, multi-layered background parallax, Y-sorting for depth layering, and visually distinct environmental geometry.

Every action-RPG or combat-focused prototype must feature responsive hitbox detection, particle or screen-space feedback on impact, enemy health bars, and an active combat loop rather than static placeholder boxes.

Never rely on minimalist floating text labels as a substitute for a polished HUD. Canvas prototypes must render atmospheric borders, stylized health/stamina meters, and clear, styled typography matching the game's setting.
